name: Wildcard Consecrated Weapon adds Holy damage to melee swings (#7367)
contract: Consecrated Weapon 200809 applies hidden buff 200819 (DBC effect 0: SPELL_AURA_DUMMY, ProcFlags 0x14, EffectBasePoints 410, EffectDieSides 1, so CalcValue deterministically yields 411 once the aura's own BaseLevel/MaxLevel/SpellLevel clamp cancels RealPointsPerLevel).
It had no spell_proc row override needed (native ProcFlags already nonzero) but no script, so the Holy damage effect never fired even though its SP/AP flat bonuses (effects 1/2) already worked.

The tooltip's '$/77;200819m1 to $/25;200819M1' divisors are weapon-speed reference points (100/1.3 and 100/4.0): the actual per-swing formula is EffectBasePoints0(411) * weaponSpeedSeconds / 100. Item 506's 3000 ms main-hand speed gives the unresisted int32(411 * 3.0 / 100) = 12 Holy damage per swing, attributed in the combat log to 200819 itself (no separate damage spell exists in this family). Holy damage against NPCs still rolls the native per-level monster resist chance (Unit::GetEffectiveResistChance, CoA.MonsterResistance.PerLevel), so the scenario bounds the observed average instead of pinning an exact post-mitigation number.

steps.label: Consecrated Holy Weapon Hidden is up
Every swing adds a Holy hit (proc count matches swing count)
Average Holy damage per swing is at most the unresisted 12 (411 * 3.0s / 100) and at least 9 (level-based NPC Holy resistance can only reduce it)
